Codex review: this still needs some work.

**Summary**
This issue establishes a remaining ACP delivery defect on current main. Related channel-delivery and snapshot-revision work covers different paths, and no open PR was found for this bridge repair.

Reproducibility: yes. from source: send an active ACP prompt a Gateway preamble item with progressText, followed by tool and final chat events; the bridge discards the preamble. No current-main runtime reproduction was executed in this read-only review.

**Next step**
Reuse the already queued implementation lane for this source-proven ACP repair; establish a failing regression and boundary proof before opening its PR.


<details>
<summary>Review details</summary>

Best possible solution:

Translate commentary preamble items through the existing ACP update owner, preserving text order, item deduplication, and replay.

Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue?

Yes, from source: send an active ACP prompt a Gateway preamble item with progressText, followed by tool and final chat events; the bridge discards the preamble. No current-main runtime reproduction was executed in this read-only review.

Is this the best way to solve the issue?

Yes: consuming the existing commentary event contract in the ACP bridge is a bounded repair. Commentary needs item-scoped accounting separate from the final-answer offset to prevent duplicated or truncated text.

AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant.

Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [725da12cc31c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/725da12cc31cbb923ca9884beddb316e3ca4ac32).

</details>

<details>
<summary>Label changes</summary>

Label changes:

No label changes.

Label justifications:

- `P2`: ACP clients silently lose substantive commentary, while tool execution and final-answer delivery remain available.
- `impact:message-loss`: Assistant plans, progress notes, and caveats are omitted from the ACP client stream.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Evidence reviewed</summary>

Acceptance criteria:

- Establish a base-failing ACP event-boundary regression for commentary, tool ordering, duplicate snapshots, and final text.
- pnpm test src/acp/translator.final-snapshots.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
- pnpm test src/acp/translator.replay.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
- pnpm check:changed
- git diff --check

What I checked:

- **Current bridge drops commentary events:** After approval handling, handleAgentEvent returns for every stream other than tool, including commentary item events. ([`src/acp/translator.agent-events.ts:62`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/8c22de3f1d06a878de0eb5c0531457584d874e82/src/acp/translator.agent-events.ts#L62), [8c22de3f1d06](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8c22de3f1d06a878de0eb5c0531457584d874e82))
- **Commentary producer:** The embedded agent publishes commentary as stream item, kind preamble, with progressText and update/end phases; it does not publish that text as an ordinary assistant event. ([`src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.reply-delivery.ts:172`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/8c22de3f1d06a878de0eb5c0531457584d874e82/src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.reply-delivery.ts#L172), [8c22de3f1d06](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8c22de3f1d06a878de0eb5c0531457584d874e82))
- **Chat snapshots do not substitute for commentary:** Gateway live-chat projection suppresses commentary. The ACP chat consumer emits text from delta/final snapshots using a separate sentText offset, so that consumer cannot recover the ignored commentary lane. ([`src/gateway/live-chat-projector.ts:231`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/8c22de3f1d06a878de0eb5c0531457584d874e82/src/gateway/live-chat-projector.ts#L231), [8c22de3f1d06](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8c22de3f1d06a878de0eb5c0531457584d874e82))
- **Existing ordering contract:** The agent subscription regression expects the preamble 'Checking current state.' before the following tool item. ACP final-snapshot coverage instead exercises append-only answer chunks. ([`src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.before-terminal-delivery.test.ts:538`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/8c22de3f1d06a878de0eb5c0531457584d874e82/src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.before-terminal-delivery.test.ts#L538), [8c22de3f1d06](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8c22de3f1d06a878de0eb5c0531457584d874e82))
- **Latest release retains the filter:** The v2026.9.9 source also returns for non-tool streams after approval handling; the release does not contain a commentary consumer. ([`src/acp/translator.agent-events.ts`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/bcfc88812a35243893585dbeca87ca41b48272ca/src/acp/translator.agent-events.ts), [bcfc88812a35](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bcfc88812a35243893585dbeca87ca41b48272ca))
- **Current-main verification:** GitHub main is 725da12cc31cbb923ca9884beddb316e3ca4ac32. Its only change after the reviewed checkout affects updater custody and associated documentation/tests, leaving the inspected ACP and commentary paths unchanged. ([725da12cc31c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/725da12cc31cbb923ca9884beddb316e3ca4ac32))

</details>

<details>
<summary>How this review workflow works</summary>

- Maintainers can also comment `@clawsweeper review` to request a fresh review only.
- Fresh-review commands do not start repair, autofix, rebase, CI repair, or automerge.
- Maintainer-only repair and merge flows require explicit commands such as `@clawsweeper autofix`, `@clawsweeper automerge`, `@clawsweeper fix ci`, or `@clawsweeper address review`.
- Maintainers can comment `@clawsweeper explain` to ask for more context, or `@clawsweeper stop` to stop active automation.

</details>

body:
Fixed on `main` by #168201 (34128f148ebe).

Assistant text that accompanies tool calls (plans, warnings, narration) was being reclassified as pre-tool commentary, and the ACP bridge then dropped it, and in some orderings also dropped or truncated the final answer. The Gateway now exposes its retained-answer projection as optional, additive preamble metadata (no protocol version bump; channel reply behavior unchanged), and the ACP bridge uses it together with commentary item IDs to show the narration exactly once and deliver the complete final answer.

Verified through the real `openclaw acp` stdio bridge against an isolated Gateway with a local model (Ollama `qwen3:8b`): before, the final vanished on a single-tool turn and lost its first 26 characters on a longer one; after, narration appeared once and both single-read and thinking-enabled two-read finals matched the Gateway's own snapshots. Both the Gateway and the ACP bridge need to be on a build containing the fix.

One known limitation tracked separately: a plain answer replacement that arrives without any preamble event can still truncate in ACP. Please reopen (or file a new issue) with an event capture if you still see tool-call narration go missing.
